data_availability_text: Data availabilityData is available on reasonable request from the UK Biobank [135] (https://www.ukbiobank.ac.uk/learn-more-about-uk-biobank/contact-us).Summary statistics from FinnGen are available online [136] (https://www.finngen.fi/en/access_results) and from the Million Veteran Project via dbGaP request [137] (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/projects/gap/cgi-bin/study.cgi?studyid=phs001672.v1.p1).GWAS summary statistics from the Psychiatric Genomics Consortium (PGC) for Alzheimer’s disease, anxiety, bipolar disorder, depression, and schizophrenia are available from their website [138] (https://pgc.unc.edu/for-researchers/download-results/). Summary statistics for anxiety from iPSYCH are also available online [139] (https://ipsych.dk/en/research/downloads). For Parkinson’s disease and ALS, summary statistics are available on GWAS Catalog [140, 141] at https://www.ebi.ac.uk/gwas/studies/ under accession numbers GCST009325 and GCST90027164, respectively. For multiple sclerosis, summary statistics are available through the IEU Open GWAS Project [142] (https://gwas.mrcieu.ac.uk/datasets/ieu-b-18/). Summary statistics for metabolites measured from Chen et al. [59] are also available on GWAS catalog [140, 141] (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/gwas/studies/) under accession numbers GCST90199621-90201020. Access to summary statistics for the metabolites measured by Hysi et al. [60] were made available following request to the original authors. Code to perform analyses is deposited on GitHub: https://github.com/lpgilchrist/metabolite_MR_neuropsychiatric.
